Class BoardDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.BoardDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BoardDTO extends Object implements Serializable
A snapshot of the complete game board state.

Sent by the server at game start and after a reconnection so that the client can fully rebuild its local VirtualModel.
